verses.76:13: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسࣰ ا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرࣰ ا

meaning: The root زمهر (zmhr) describes intense states. It can refer to stars shining brightly, an eye reddening with anger, a face contorting into a grin or stern look, or a day becoming intensely cold.
